title: Introduction to mapMementoR
text: mapMementoR R package creating beautiful, print-ready maps running routes, races, hiking trails, multi-day adventures GPX data. package combines GPS track data OpenStreetMap backgrounds, elevation profiles, customizable styling produce publication-quality visualizations.

title: Introduction to mapMementoR
code: # Install from GitHub pak::pak("blenback/mapMementoR") library(mapMementoR)

title: Introduction to mapMementoR
text: Single Route Maps (memento_map_series()): Create maps showing individual routes performance data (e.g., race times across multiple years) Multi-Track Maps (multitrack_map_series()): Combine multiple GPS tracks single map (e.g., relay stages, multi-day events)

title: Introduction to mapMementoR
text: workflows use YAML files define data: Races YAML: Defines individual races GPX files performance entries Track Sets YAML: Defines collections tracks plot together

title: Introduction to mapMementoR
text: Six professionally designed color schemes: - Dark: Warm gold deep navy - Emerald: Forest green cream - Nautical: Blue-grey warm cream - Zen: Charcoal light grey - Ghost: White dark background - Obsidian: Bright gold black
